description: Room Humidity 88-94%RH, Room Temp 64.0F vs 69.0F setpoint. Reheat Cmd shows 100% via Reheat Override but Discharge Temp only 57.3F and room hasn't recovered - reheat may not actually be producing heat despite override. Last real BAS alarm logged 7/20 ~10:11 AM at 71%RH; by 7/21 hand-held reader (Jesse Hinkle) found 94%RH with no new BAS alarm in between - possible sensor/alarm-routing gap. Also: ~12 other rooms (Rm 316, 240A, 314, 240, 214, 311, 241 Cell Bio, 241 Lab 2, 220, 215, 217, 312) all threw Room Humidity alarms in the same ~45 min window (9:20-10:05 AM) plus 2 Room Pressure alarms - pattern suggests central AHU/plant issue rather than N independent room faults. Conner (WWG) scheduled on site 7/22 AM, Zaal to connect with him there.
